card.name: Word before "profile" in drug properties
card.fires_on: A noun or modifier such as safety, risk, absorption or time-action that sits right before where the word "profile" is expected, in drug-effect descriptions.

modes.label: Safety or risk before profile
modes.description: The word safety, risk or side-effect precedes an expected "profile" when describing a drug's adverse effects.
modes.example: consistent with the known<< safety>> profile of alpelisib and included

modes.label: Absorption or timing before profile
modes.description: Pharmacokinetic words like absorption, time-action or elimination that lead into "profile" or "characteristics".
modes.example: The duration of separation depends upon the<< absorption>> characteristics of the medication concomitantly

card.writes: It pushes the model to write "profile" next.
card.plain: It spots the spot where the word "profile" is about to come, as in "safety profile".
